'''Sannō Shrine''' (山王神社) refers to various {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrines}} across Japan based on {{ill|Sannō Faith|ja|山王信仰}}.

* '''Hokkaido and Tōhoku Region'''
**  {{ill|Sannō Shrine (Tomakomai City)|ja|山王神社 (苫小牧市)}} - Located adjacent to Hokkaido University’s experimental forest. In recent years, a large torii gate was damaged by a typhoon, leaving only its base.
**  {{ill|Sannō Shrine (Takahata Town)|ja|山王神社 (高畠町)}} - Located in {{ill|Takahata, Yamagata|en|Takahata, Yamagata|qid=Q772103|lt=Takahata Town}}, Higashiokitama District, Yamagata Prefecture.

* '''Kantō and Kōshin Region'''
**  {{ill|Sannō Shrine|ja|山王神社 (桜川市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sannō Shrine (Sakuragawa City)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q119929523}} - Located in {{ill|Sakuragawa, Ibaraki|en|Sakuragawa, Ibaraki|qid=Q990350|lt=Sakuragawa City}}, Ibaraki Prefecture.
**  {{ill|Sannō Shrine (Edogawa Ward)|ja|山王神社 (江戸川区)}} - Located in {{ill|Edogawa, Tokyo|en|Edogawa, Tokyo|qid=Q214056|lt=Edogawa Ward}}, Tokyo Metropolis.
**  {{ill|Sannō Shrine (Hachiōji City)|ja|山王神社 (八王子市)}} - Located in {{ill|Hachiōji|en|Hachiōji|qid=Q208863|lt=Hachiōji City}}, Tokyo Metropolis.
**  {{ill|Sannō Shrine|ja|山王神社 (小田原市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sannō Shrine (Odawara City)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q134892431}} - Located in {{ill|Odawara|en|Odawara|qid=Q267258|lt=Odawara City}}, Kanagawa Prefecture.
